instruction: Покажи количество evaluation results по model для последнего evaluation run.
input:
PostgreSQL schema:
- chat_messages(id VARCHAR(36), session_id VARCHAR(36), role VARCHAR(32), content TEXT, model VARCHAR(255), provider VARCHAR(64), latency_ms INTEGER, metadata_json JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
- chat_sessions(id VARCHAR(36), title TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
- conversation_summaries(id VARCHAR(36), session_id VARCHAR(36), summary TEXT, message_count_at_update INTEGER, features JSONB, metadata_json JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
- evaluation_results(id VARCHAR(36), run_id VARCHAR(36), scenario_id VARCHAR(64), scenario_name VARCHAR(255), prompt TEXT, model VARCHAR(255), provider VARCHAR(64), response TEXT, latency_ms INTEGER, score_threshold FLOAT, source_count INTEGER, sources JSONB, retrieval JSONB, query_hints JSONB, context_policy JSONB, quality_flags JSONB, error TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
- evaluation_runs(id VARCHAR(36), name VARCHAR(255), checklist_version VARCHAR(255), models JSONB, scenario_count INTEGER, status VARCHAR(32), notes TEXT, metadata_json JSONB, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
- rag_request_logs(id VARCHAR(36), message TEXT, response TEXT, model VARCHAR(255), provider VARCHAR(64), latency_ms INTEGER, collection VARCHAR(255), score_threshold FLOAT, features JSONB, source_types JSONB, diversity JSONB, retrieval JSONB, query_hints JSONB, context_policy JSONB, prompt_tokens_estimate INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
- rag_source_logs(id VARCHAR(36), request_log_id VARCHAR(36), source_index INTEGER, qdrant_point_id VARCHAR(255), score FLOAT, title TEXT, source_type VARCHAR(255), source_path TEXT, feature JSONB, metadata_json JSONB, content_excerpt TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
output: SELECT er.model, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM evaluation_results er WHERE er.run_id = (SELECT id FROM evaluation_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY er.model ORDER BY result_count DESC
